Name: Spotify Mini Player
Author: ragdez212121
Description:
[center][size=6][b]🎵 Spotify & System Media Player (Mini Player)[/b][/size][/center]

[i]Bring your favorite tunes directly into Pelican Town! A cozy, vanilla-styled in-game music player integrated into Stardew Valley's pause menu, featuring custom pixel art, magical floating particles, an animated walking Junimo, and full support for both [b]Spotify[/b] and [b]PC / System Audio[/b] (YouTube, browsers, VLC, etc.).[/i]

[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] [b]🍏 Animated Walking Junimo:[/b] An authentic Junimo patrols back and forth across the top wooden rail of the player, dancing and walking to the beat while music is playing![/*]
[*][b]🎨 Adaptive Song Background:[/b] The inner canvas dynamically samples and tints itself with the ambient colors of the current album artwork. Every song brings its own unique visual vibe![/*]
[*][b]✨ Magical Floating Particles:[/b] A continuous, gentle stream of floating mini-Junimos, glowing star sparkles, and musical notes float across the player while music is active, with burst particles on button clicks.[/*]
[*][b]📻 Retro Marquee Scrolling:[/b] Long track names slide smoothly from right to left like a vintage car radio so you never miss a song title.[/*]
[*][b]⏳ Interactive Timeline & Progress Bar:[/b] Displays current and total track time (01:23 / 03:45) with a carved wooden groove and golden bead. Click anywhere on the bar to scrub/seek directly to that part of the song![/*]
[*][b]🔊 Interactive Volume Slider:[/b] Carved Stardew-style slider controlling either Spotify's playback volume or your Windows Master Volume in real-time.[/*]
[*][b]🔁 Full Control Deck:[/b] Custom carved pixel art buttons for Previous, Play/Pause, Next, Favorite/Like, Repeat/Loop, and Shuffle.[/*]
[*][b]🎛️ Dual-Mode System (Spotify ⇄ PC Mode):[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Spotify Mode:[/b] Full Web API integration with live album art, track progress, and playback controls.[/*]
[*][b]PC / System Mode:[/b] [b]No Spotify account or setup required![/b] Directly controls whatever is playing on your computer (YouTube, Chrome, Edge, VLC, media players) using native Windows media keys and adjusts Windows master volume![/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]🔔 HUD Song Toast Notifications:[/b] Shows a discreet, cozy 3.5-second notification box in the top-left corner whenever a new song starts playing while you are farming or mining.[/*]
[*][b]⌨️ Global Hotkeys:[/b] Control your music anywhere in the game without pausing (F7 for Previous, F8 for Play/Pause, F9 for Next by default).[/*]
[*][b]🪟 Draggable & Proportional Scaling:[/b] Click and drag the wooden frame to place it anywhere on screen (position is saved automatically). Drag the bottom-right corner grip to scale the entire player up or down proportionally![/*]
[*][b]🛑 Auto-Pause on Exit:[/b] Automatically pauses playback when you close Stardew Valley so your music doesn't keep running in the background.[/*]
[*][b]💬 Startup Prompt:[/b] Option on the title screen to silently launch Spotify minimized if it isn't running yet.[/*]
[*][b]🌐 Full English & Spanish Support:[/b] Complete bilingual support out of the box.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]📦 Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b][/url] (version 4.0.0 or higher)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url] (Recommended to configure settings in-game)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*] Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].[/*]
[*]Download this mod's [b].zip[/b] file.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]SpotifyMiniPlayer[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b] directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI![/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🔑 Spotify Setup Guide (Takes 1 Minute)[/b][/size]

[quote][b]Note:[/b] Controlling Spotify playback via code requires a [b]Spotify Premium[/b] account. If you do not have Premium or don't want to use Spotify, simply switch to [b]PC Mode[/b] inside the mod to control YouTube/browser audio for free without any setup![/quote]
[list=1]
[*] Go to the [url=https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard][b]Spotify Developer Dashboard[/b][/url] and log in with your Spotify account.[/*]
[*]Click [b]Create App[/b].[/*]
[*]Fill in the basic info:
[list]
[*] [b]App Name:[/b] Stardew Mini Player[/*]
[*][b]App Description:[/b] Music player mod[/*]
[*][b]Redirect URIs:[/b] [color=#00cc44][b]http://127.0.0.1:5543/callback[/b][/color] [i](Important: Enter this exact URL! Do not use "localhost")[/i][/*]
[*]Check the [b]Web API[/b] box.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Click [b]Save[/b].[/*]
[*]Go to the [b]Settings[/b] tab and copy your [b]Client ID[/b].[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley, click the [b]Mod Settings cog (GMCM)[/b] in the bottom-left corner of the title screen or pause menu, select [b]Spotify Mini Player[/b], and paste your [b]Client ID[/b].[/*]
[*]Authorize your browser once when prompted. That's it! Your login token is saved locally and will never ask you again.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🎮 Controls & Shortcuts[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] [b]Move Player:[/b] Left Click + Drag anywhere on the wooden frame[/*]
[*][b]Resize Player:[/b] Left Click + Drag the bottom-right grip corner[/*]
[*][b]Seek / Scrub:[/b] Left Click anywhere on the golden timeline progress bar[/*]
[*][b]Volume:[/b] Left Click / Drag the golden volume bar[/*]
[*][b]Play / Pause:[/b] [b]F8[/b] (Global hotkey, works without pausing)[/*]
[*][b]Next Track:[/b] [b]F9[/b] (Global hotkey, works without pausing)[/*]
[*][b]Previous Track:[/b] [b]F7[/b] (Global hotkey, works without pausing)[/*]
[*][b]Switch Mode:[/b] Left Click the bottom tab [b][ Spotify Mode ][/b] to toggle PC Mode[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[spoiler]
[size=5][b]🎵 Reproductor de Música Mini (Spotify & PC) para Stardew Valley[/b][/size]

Un reproductor de música integrado al estilo vanilla dentro del menú de pausa de Stardew Valley, con pixel art original, partículas mágicas, un Junimo animado y compatibilidad con [b]Spotify[/b] y [b]Audio de PC[/b] (YouTube, navegadores, juegos y reproductores locales).

[b]Características:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Junimo Caminante:[/b] Camina y baila sobre la viga de madera superior al ritmo de la música.[/*]
[*][b]Fondo Camaleónico:[/b] El color del fondo cambia automáticamente adaptándose a la carátula del álbum de cada canción.[/*]
[*][b]Partículas Mágicas:[/b] Lluvia de 70 partículas de mini Junimos, estrellas doradas y notas musicales.[/*]
[*][b]Timeline y Volumen interactivos:[/b] Adelanta o atrasa la canción haciendo clic en la barra y controla el volumen de forma fluida.[/*]
[*][b]Modo Doble (Spotify ⇄ PC):[/b] Cambia con un clic entre Spotify y el control nativo de Windows (YouTube/navegadores sin necesidad de cuentas ni Spotify Premium).[/*]
[*][b]Notificación Toast HUD:[/b] Ventanita flotante que avisa qué canción empezó a sonar mientras caminas por el pueblo.[/*]
[*][b]Atajos de teclado:[/b] F7, F8 y F9 para pasar o pausar música mientras juegas sin abrir el menú.[/*]
[*][b]Móvil y Redimensionable:[/b] Arrástralo a cualquier parte de la pantalla o cambia su tamaño con la esquina inferior derecha.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Instalación:[/b]
[list=1]
[*] Instala [b]SMAPI[/b] y [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].[/*]
[*]Descomprime la carpeta del mod dentro de [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b].[/*]
[*]Inicia el juego.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Configurar Spotify (Solo toma 1 minuto):[/b]
[list=1]
[*] Entra a [url=https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard][b]Spotify Developer Dashboard[/b][/url] e inicia sesión.[/*]
[*]Haz clic en [b]Create App[/b].[/*]
[*]Pon cualquier nombre y en [b]Redirect URIs[/b] añade: [color=#00cc44][b]http://127.0.0.1:5543/callback[/b][/color]. Marca la casilla [b]Web API[/b] y guarda.[/*]
[*]En [b]Settings[/b], copia tu [b]Client ID[/b].[/*]
[*]Abre Stardew Valley, entra a la rueda de configuración de [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] y pega tu [b]Client ID[/b]. ¡Listo![/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[line]
